profile.summary: Based on the limited data provided, natipo has experience with jQuery, particularly in the context of DOM manipulation and event handling. They have a good understanding of maintaining backward compatibility in JavaScript applications, as evidenced by their work on bringing back QtWebKit support for jQuery 3.x. However, the data does not provide sufficient information to make definitive statements about natipo's expertise in other areas of the JavaScript ecosystem, such as modern JavaScript features, TypeScript, API development, asynchronous programming, testing frameworks, build tools, or code quality practices. To gain a more comprehensive understanding, additional review data or more detailed review comments would be necessary.
